ten: Make Us Yours, and Ours After Us
pen: Asking for submission for oneself and for one's children, and for mercy when we fall short.
ken: Read for the household: when you want what you practise to outlast you rather than stop with you.
aen: The continuation of Ibrahim and Isma'il's prayer at the House, extended to their descendants.
t: Jadikan Kami Milik-Mu, Dan Keturunan Kami
p: Memohon ketundukan untuk diri dan anak cucu, serta rahmat ketika kita tergelincir.
keg: Dibaca untuk keluarga: apabila kita mahu amalan ini berterusan selepas kita, bukan berhenti pada kita.
asb: Sambungan doa Ibrahim dan Isma'il di sisi Baitullah, diperluas kepada keturunan.
art: A doorway seen from inside a home at dusk, a child's sandals beside an adult's. Warm, ordinary, nobody in frame.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
my: "Wahai Tuhan kami! Jadikanlah kami berdua: orang-orang Islam (yang berserah diri) kepadaMu, dan jadikanlah daripada keturunan kami: umat Islam (yang berserah diri) kepadamu, dan tunjukkanlah kepada kami syariat dan cara-cara ibadat kami, dan terimalah taubat kami; sesungguhnya Engkaulah Maha Penerima taubat, lagi Maha Mengasihani;
tr: rabbanā wa-ij'ʿalnā mus'limayni laka wamin dhurriyyatinā ummatan mus'limatan laka wa-arinā manāsikanā watub ʿalaynā innaka anta l-tawābu l-raḥīmu

pen: Asking for good in this life and the next, and for safety from the Fire.
ken: The shortest complete request in the Qur'an: read when you do not know what to ask for.
aen: Set against the prayer of those who ask only for this world, in the verses on the rites of Hajj.
p: Memohon kebaikan di dunia dan di akhirat, serta dilindungi daripada azab neraka.
keg: Permintaan paling ringkas yang lengkap: dibaca ketika kita tidak tahu apa hendak dipohon.
asb: Diletakkan bertentangan dengan doa mereka yang hanya meminta dunia, dalam ayat-ayat tentang haji.
art: A road at dusk seen from a rise, a lit town on one side and open dark country on the other. One traveller, from behind.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami, berilah kami kebaikan di dunia dan kebaikan di akhirat, dan peliharalah kami dari azab neraka".
tr: rabbanā ātinā fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wafī l-ākhirati ḥasanatan waqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri

pen: Asking for patience, firm footing and help when facing something far larger than you.
ken: Read before what you are outmatched by: the interview, the ward, the court date, the confrontation.
aen: Spoken by Talut's small company as they came in sight of Jalut and his army.
p: Memohon kesabaran, ketetapan pendirian dan pertolongan ketika berdepan sesuatu yang jauh lebih besar.
keg: Dibaca sebelum berdepan perkara yang kita tidak setanding — temu duga, wad, mahkamah, pertelingkahan.
asb: Diucapkan oleh pasukan kecil Talut ketika mula terpandang Jalut dan tenteranya.
art: A narrow line of figures at the edge of a wide plain at dawn, seen from behind and far off. Scale, not conflict.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Limpahkanlah sabar kepada kami, dan teguhkanlah tapak pendirian kami serta menangkanlah kami terhadap kaum yang kafir.
tr: rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wathabbit aqdāmanā wa-unṣur'nā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīna

ten: The Day There Is No Doubt About
pen: An affirmation turned into prayer: that God gathers mankind for a day whose coming is certain.
ken: Read when the present feels like the whole of the story.
aen: Follows the prayer for steadfast hearts, grounding it in what is coming.
p: Pengakuan yang menjadi doa: Allah menghimpunkan manusia pada hari yang pasti datang.
keg: Dibaca ketika hari ini terasa seperti keseluruhan cerita.
asb: Menyusuli doa memohon ketetapan hati, mengaitkannya dengan apa yang akan datang.
art: A horizon line at first light with a crowd of small distant figures, none distinct. Gathering, not judgement.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
my: "Wahai Tuhan kami! Sesungguhnya Engkaulah yang akan menghimpunkan sekalian manusia, untuk (menerima balasan pada) suatu hari (hari kiamat) yang tidak ada syak padanya". Sesungguhnya Allah tidak memungkiri janjiNya.
tr: rabbanā innaka jāmiʿu l-nāsi liyawmin lā rayba fīhi inna l-laha lā yukh'lifu l-mīʿāda

pen: Faith offered as the ground of the request, and safety from the Fire as the request itself.
ken: Read when you have little to present but belief itself.
aen: The words of those who are patient, truthful and give in charity, described in the same passage.
p: Iman dijadikan asas permohonan, dan selamat daripada api neraka sebagai permohonannya.
keg: Dibaca ketika tiada apa untuk diajukan selain iman itu sendiri.
asb: Ucapan mereka yang sabar, benar dan berinfak, sebagaimana disebut dalam ayat yang sama.
art: Open empty hands held low, palms up, in plain daylight. Nothing in them.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Sesungguhnya kami telah beriman, oleh itu, ampunkanlah dosa-dosa kami dan peliharalah kami dari azab neraka".
tr: rabbanā innanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā waqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri

pen: Belief and following declared together, with the request to be recorded among those who bore witness.
ken: Read when you want your name on the side you have chosen.
aen: Spoken by the disciples of 'Isa when they declared themselves helpers of God.
t: Catatkanlah Kami Bersama Orang Yang Menyaksikan
p: Iman dan ikutan diucapkan serentak, dengan permohonan agar dicatat bersama para saksi.
keg: Dibaca apabila kita mahu nama kita tercatat di pihak yang kita pilih.
asb: Diucapkan oleh para hawariyyun, pengikut 'Isa, ketika menyatakan diri sebagai penolong agama Allah.
art: A name being entered in a ledger by lamplight, the pen mid-stroke. Hand only.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
my: "Wahai Tuhan kami! Kami telah beriman kepada apa yang telah Engkau turunkan, dan kami mengikut RasulMu; oleh itu suratkanlah kami beserta orang-orang yang menjadi saksi (yang mengakui keesaanMu dan kebenaran RasulMu)".
tr: rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ittabaʿnā l-rasūla fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīna

ten: You Did Not Make This For Nothing
pen: Reflection on creation turning into a plea for protection from the Fire.
ken: Read outdoors, or at night, when the size of things is what you are looking at.
aen: The prayer of those who remember God standing, sitting and lying down, and reflect on the heavens and the earth.
p: Perenungan terhadap ciptaan yang menjadi permohonan perlindungan daripada api neraka.
keg: Dibaca di luar rumah atau pada waktu malam, ketika kebesaran alam yang sedang kita pandang.
asb: Doa mereka yang mengingati Allah sambil berdiri, duduk dan berbaring, serta memikirkan kejadian langit dan bumi.
art: A night sky over a flat landscape, one small figure seated at the bottom edge of the frame.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Tidaklah Engkau menjadikan benda-benda ini dengan sia-sia, Maha Suci Engkau, maka peliharalah kami dari azab neraka.
tr: rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri

ten: The Weight of Being Turned Away
pen: Naming what disgrace would mean, as the reason the request matters.
ken: Read when you need the seriousness of the asking to be in front of you.
aen: Continues the prayer of those who reflect, in the closing passage of Al 'Imran.
p: Menyebut apa erti kehinaan itu, sebagai sebab permohonan ini penting.
keg: Dibaca ketika kita perlu merasai betapa seriusnya permintaan ini.
asb: Sambungan doa mereka yang merenung, dalam ayat-ayat penutup surah Ali 'Imran.
art: A closed gate at the end of a walled lane, seen straight on at dusk.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Sebenarnya sesiapa yang Engkau masukkan ke dalam neraka maka sesungguhnya Engkau telah menghinakannya, dan orang-orang yang zalim tidak akan beroleh seorang penolong pun;
tr: rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣārin

ten: We Heard the Call and Answered
pen: Having answered the call to faith, asking for sins covered, misdeeds removed, and a death among the righteous.
ken: Read when you want the end to match the answer you already gave.
aen: The same passage: the caller to faith is heard, and the prayer follows.
t: Kami Dengar Seruan Itu Lalu Kami Sahut
p: Setelah menyahut seruan iman, memohon dosa ditutup, kesalahan dihapus, dan mati bersama orang yang baik.
keg: Dibaca apabila kita mahu penghujung selaras dengan jawapan yang sudah kita beri.
asb: Dalam ayat yang sama: penyeru kepada iman didengari, lalu doa ini menyusul.
art: An open window at night with a light on inside, seen from the street. Someone answered.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Sesungguhnya kami telah mendengar seorang Penyeru (Rasul) yang menyeru kepada iman, katanya: ` Berimanlah kamu kepada Tuhan kamu ', maka kami pun beriman. Wahai Tuhan kami, ampunkanlah dosa-dosa kami, dan hapuskanlah daripada kami kesalahan-kesalahan kami, dan matikanlah kami bersama orang-orang yang berbakti;
tr: rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrāri

pen: Holding to the promise made through the messengers, and asking not to be disgraced.
ken: Read when waiting is the hard part and the promise is all you are holding.
aen: The closing petition of the same prayer in Al 'Imran.
p: Berpegang pada janji yang disampaikan melalui para rasul, dan memohon agar tidak dihinakan.
keg: Dibaca ketika penantian itu yang berat, dan janji itu sahaja yang kita pegang.
asb: Permohonan penutup dalam doa yang sama di surah Ali 'Imran.
art: A folded letter held in one hand, unopened, on a lap. Waiting.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise."
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Berikanlah kepada kami pahala yang telah Engkau janjikan kepada kami melalui Rasul-rasulMu, dan janganlah Engkau hinakan kami pada hari kiamat; sesungguhnya Engkau tidak memungkiri janji".
tr: rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿāda

pen: Recognition arriving with tears, and the request to be counted among those who witness.
ken: Read when something true has just landed and you do not want the feeling to pass without being fixed.
aen: The response of those whose eyes overflowed when they heard what was revealed to the Messenger.
p: Pengiktirafan yang datang bersama air mata, dan permohonan agar dikira bersama para saksi.
keg: Dibaca ketika sesuatu yang benar baru sahaja meresap, dan kita tidak mahu rasa itu berlalu begitu sahaja.
asb: Jawapan mereka yang bergenang air mata ketika mendengar apa yang diturunkan kepada Rasul.
art: A face turned away at the edge of frame, lamplight on a cheek. Recognition, not display.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami, kami beriman (kepada Nabi Muhammad dan Kitab Suci Al-Quran), oleh itu tetapkanlah kami bersama-sama orang-orang yang menjadi saksi (yang mengakui kebenaran Nabi Muhammad s.a.w).
tr: rabbanā āmannā fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīna

ten: Send Down a Table For Us
pen: Asking for provision that is also a sign, and naming God the best of providers.
ken: Read over a meal that had to be asked for, or when the month's provision is not yet in sight.
aen: The prayer of 'Isa son of Maryam when his disciples asked for a table from heaven.
p: Memohon rezeki yang sekali gus menjadi tanda, sambil menyebut Allah sebaik-baik pemberi rezeki.
keg: Dibaca ketika menghadapi hidangan yang terpaksa dipohon, atau ketika rezeki bulan ini belum kelihatan.
asb: Doa 'Isa anak Maryam ketika para hawariyyun meminta hidangan dari langit.
art: An empty low table set for several people, plates bare, evening light. Set, not served.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: O Allāh, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.
my: Isa ibni Maryam (pun berdoalah ke hadrat Allah dengan) berkata: Ya Allah, Tuhan kami! Turunkanlah kiranya kepada kami satu hidangan dari langit, untuk menjadi hari raya bagi kami, iaitu bagi kami yang ada hari ini dan bagi orang-orang kami yang datang kemudian, dan sebagai satu tanda (mukjizat) daripadamu (yang menunjukkan kebesaran dan kekuasaanMu); dan kurniakanlah rezeki kepada kami, kerana Engkau jualah sebaik-baik Pemberi rezeki".
tr: l-lahuma rabbanā anzil ʿalaynā māidatan mina l-samāi takūnu lanā ʿīdan li-awwalinā waākhirinā waāyatan minka wa-ur'zuq'nā wa-anta khayru l-rāziqīna

pen: Handing a dispute over to the best of deciders rather than settling it yourself.
ken: Read when a disagreement has gone past what you can resolve, and you are letting it go up.
aen: Spoken by Shu'ayb to his people when they threatened to drive him out.
p: Menyerahkan pertikaian kepada sebaik-baik hakim, bukan menyelesaikannya sendiri.
keg: Dibaca apabila perselisihan sudah melampaui kemampuan kita, dan kita menyerahkannya ke atas.
asb: Diucapkan oleh Syu'aib kepada kaumnya ketika mereka mengancam untuk mengusirnya.
art: Two chairs facing each other across an empty table, nobody seated, level daylight.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allāh we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami, hukumkanlah antara kami dan kaum kami dengan kebenaran (keadilan), kerana Engkau jualah sebaik-baik Hakim".
tr: rabbanā if'taḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bil-ḥaqi wa-anta khayru l-fātiḥīna

pen: Under threat, asking not for escape but for patience and a good end.
ken: Read when the cost of staying honest has become real.
aen: The answer of the magicians of Pharaoh after they believed and he threatened them.
p: Di bawah ancaman, memohon bukan jalan keluar tetapi kesabaran dan pengakhiran yang baik.
keg: Dibaca apabila harga untuk terus jujur sudah menjadi nyata.
asb: Jawapan ahli sihir Firaun setelah mereka beriman dan diancam olehnya.
art: A row of shadows cast long on stone at low sun, the figures out of frame. Standing, not fleeing.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
my: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah kesabaran kepada kami, dan matikanlah kami dalam keadaan Islam (berserah bulat-bulat kepadaMu)".
tr: rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā mus'limīna

ten: Do Not Make Us a Test For Them
pen: Asking not to become the means by which cruel people are confirmed in their cruelty, and to be delivered by mercy.
ken: Read when your situation is being used by someone else to justify themselves.
aen: The prayer of the young followers of Musa who believed in the face of Pharaoh's power.
t: Jangan Jadikan Kami Fitnah Bagi Mereka
p: Memohon agar kita tidak menjadi sebab orang zalim bertambah zalim, dan agar diselamatkan dengan rahmat-Nya.
keg: Dibaca ketika keadaan kita digunakan oleh orang lain untuk membenarkan diri mereka.
asb: Doa golongan muda pengikut Musa yang beriman dalam bayang kekuasaan Firaun.
art: A small group standing apart in an open courtyard, seen from a high window. Watched.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Janganlah Engkau jadikan kami landasan fitnah kesengsaraan bagi kaum yang zalim ganas. " Dan selamatkanlah kami dengan rahmatMu dari angkara kaum yang kafir".
tr: rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīna

pen: Stating plainly that nothing is concealed, before asking for anything at all.
ken: Read when you cannot put the request into words, or do not want to.
aen: Part of Ibrahim's long prayer after settling his family by the House.
t: Engkau Mengetahui Apa Yang Kami Sembunyikan
p: Menyatakan terus terang bahawa tiada apa yang tersembunyi, sebelum meminta apa-apa.
keg: Dibaca ketika kita tidak mampu, atau tidak mahu, memberi kata pada permintaan itu.
asb: Sebahagian daripada doa panjang Ibrahim setelah menempatkan keluarganya di sisi Baitullah.
art: A closed hand resting on a table, unopened. Nothing shown.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allāh on the earth or in the heaven.
my: "Wahai Tuhan kami! Sesungguhnya Engkau mengetahui akan apa yang kami sembunyikan dan apa yang kami zahirkan; dan tiada sesuatupun di langit dan di bumi, yang tersembunyi kepada Allah!
tr: rabbanā innaka taʿlamu mā nukh'fī wamā nuʿ'linu wamā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min shayin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi

ten: Keep Me, and Mine, In Prayer
pen: Asking to be established in prayer along with one's descendants, and for the prayer to be accepted.
ken: Read when prayer has become hard to keep, or when you are trying to hand it on.
aen: Ibrahim's prayer for himself and his descendants, in the same passage.
t: Tetapkanlah Aku Dan Keturunanku Dalam Solat
p: Memohon agar tetap mendirikan solat bersama keturunan, dan agar doa itu diterima.
keg: Dibaca ketika solat mula sukar dijaga, atau ketika kita cuba mewariskannya.
asb: Doa Ibrahim untuk dirinya dan keturunannya, dalam ayat yang sama.
art: Two prayer mats laid side by side, one adult sized and one small, both empty, morning light.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
my: "Wahai Tuhanku! Jadikanlah daku orang yang mendirikan sembahyang dan demikianlah juga zuriat keturunanku. Wahai Tuhan kami, perkenankanlah doa permohonanku.
tr: rabbi ij'ʿalnī muqīma l-ṣalati wamin dhurriyyatī rabbanā wataqabbal duʿāi

pen: Naming the fear out loud before going to face the thing feared.
ken: Read before a confrontation you have been sent into and would rather avoid.
aen: Musa and Harun before going to Pharaoh.
p: Menyebut ketakutan itu secara terbuka sebelum pergi menghadapinya.
keg: Dibaca sebelum berdepan sesuatu yang kita ditugaskan menghadapinya walaupun kita mahu mengelak.
asb: Musa dan Harun sebelum menghadap Firaun.
art: A long corridor with a door at the far end, seen from the near end. Nobody in it yet.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Sesungguhnya kami takut bahawa ia akan segera menyeksa kami, atau ia akan melampau batas".
tr: rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭghā

pen: The plainest form of the request, with God named the best of the merciful.
ken: Read when you want nothing added to the asking.
aen: Quoted as the words of a group of God's servants who were mocked for saying it.
p: Bentuk permohonan yang paling ringkas, dengan menyebut Allah sebaik-baik pemberi rahmat.
keg: Dibaca apabila kita mahu permintaan itu tanpa tambahan apa-apa.
asb: Dirakamkan sebagai ucapan sekumpulan hamba Allah yang diperolok-olokkan kerana mengucapkannya.
art: A plain wall and a single shaft of light on it. Nothing else.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami, kami telah beriman; oleh itu ampunkanlah dosa kami serta berilah rahmat kepada kami, dan sememangnya Engkaulah jua sebaik-baik Pemberi rahmat '.
tr: rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna

pen: Praise once grief has been taken away, naming the Lord as Forgiving and Appreciative.
ken: Read when something heavy has finally lifted — the result that came back clear, the debt settled, the waiting over.
aen: The words of the people of the Garden as they enter it.
p: Pujian setelah dukacita diangkat, sambil menyebut Tuhan Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Mensyukuri.
keg: Dibaca apabila sesuatu yang berat akhirnya terangkat — keputusan yang selamat, hutang yang selesai, penantian yang tamat.
asb: Ucapan ahli syurga ketika memasukinya.
art: A window thrown open onto morning light, the room behind it still dark. Relief arriving, nobody in frame.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -.
my: Segala puji tertentu bagi Allah, yang telah menghapuskan perasaan dukacita dari kami; Sesungguhnya Tuhan kami Maha Pengampun, lagi sentiasa memberi balasan yang sebaik-baiknya (kepada orang-orang yang taat).
tr: l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun

ten: And Bring In Those With Them
pen: Asking that the righteous among a person's parents, spouses and children be admitted alongside them, and be shielded from their own misdeeds.
ken: Read when you do not want to arrive alone.
aen: The continuation of the same prayer of the bearers of the Throne.
p: Memohon agar orang soleh dalam kalangan ibu bapa, pasangan dan keturunan dimasukkan bersama mereka, serta dipelihara daripada kejahatan diri.
keg: Dibaca apabila kita tidak mahu sampai ke sana seorang diri.
asb: Sambungan doa para pemikul Arasy yang sama.
art: A gate standing open onto a garden, several sets of footprints going in together.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
my: "Wahai Tuhan kami! Dan masukkanlah mereka ke dalam Syurga "Adn" yang Engkau telah janjikan kepada mereka; dan (masukkanlah bersama-sama mereka): orang-orang yang layak di antara ibu bapa mereka, dan isteri-isteri mereka, serta keturunan mereka. Sesungguhnya Engkaulah jua Yang Maha Kuasa, lagi Maha Bijaksana. "Dan peliharalah mereka dari (balasan) kejahatan-kejahatan (yang dilakukannya); dan (sebenarnya) sesiapa yang Engkau pelihara pada hari itu dari terkena (balasan) kejahatan-kejahatan (yang dilakukannya) maka sesungguhnya Engkau telah mengurniakan rahmat kepadanya; dan yang demikian itulah kemenangan yang besar (nilainya)".
tr: rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu

ten: On You We Rely, To You We Turn
pen: Reliance, repentance and return stated in one line.
ken: Read when a decision is made and the outcome is no longer yours to hold.
aen: Part of the example set by Ibrahim and those with him, cited in al-Mumtahanah.
t: Kepada-Mu Kami Bertawakal, Kepada-Mu Kami Kembali
p: Tawakal, taubat dan kepulangan dinyatakan dalam satu baris.
keg: Dibaca apabila keputusan sudah dibuat dan hasilnya bukan lagi milik kita.
asb: Sebahagian daripada teladan Ibrahim dan mereka yang bersamanya, sebagaimana disebut dalam surah al-Mumtahanah.
art: A boat's mooring rope let go from a post, the water beyond out of focus.
srcProse: translation Saheeh International; transliteration api.quran.com (per-word); Malay Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih
en: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
my: Wahai Tuhan kami! Kepada Engkaulah sahaja kami berserah diri, dan kepada Engkaulah kami rujuk bertaubat, serta kepada Engkaulah jua tempat kembali!
tr: rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ilayka anabnā wa-ilayka l-maṣīru
